note: Master seed registry. Every experiment reads seeds from here; never reseed ad hoc.

phase1_uniform.description: Dirichlet(1) draws per context over P(.|z) for z in {0,1}; batch b uses seed b.

phase1_boundary.description: Near-facet sampling: feasible points interpolated toward facet-violating directions at log-spaced distances; plus exact polytope vertices.

phase1_inflation_subsample.description: Subsample of uniform+boundary instances cross-checked against order-2 inflation LP (marginals + conditional-independence constraints).

phase2.note: Discrete-witness statistical engine. Null streams draw fresh IV-form SCMs per replication; alternative streams use the predeclared mixture-strength family. Bootstrap draw seeds derive deterministically as dataset_seed * 1000 + replicate_index (mod 2^31).
phase2.note_kinds: inert_u dropped: U drawn but mechanism-independent is distributionally identical to chain (same observable-law generator); redundant null.
phase2.triage_note: D2: adaptive bootstrap on clean arm only; contaminated arms evaluated against pooled clean CVs. Boot subsets per kind; pooled draws per (cell,n,stat,engine) >= 2400 everywhere.
